assertions.name: codex-launch-options-exist-in-local-cli
assertions.evidence: capabilities.yaml uses 'codex --full-auto' (valid), 'codex resume' (valid), '--model' flag (valid). The retired CLI-agent skill used the same valid Codex launch family. No stale pre-0.111 syntax used.

assertions.name: supported-exec-form-is-not-marked-invalid
assertions.evidence: capabilities.yaml does not mark codex exec as invalid. The binary entry is 'binary: codex' without syntax restrictions. No 'invalid' labels applied to exec form.

assertions.name: native-worktree-is-marked-unavailable
assertions.evidence: capabilities.yaml codex entry: 'worktree: manual  # No native. git worktree add + ln -s node_modules'. Contrasts with claude: 'worktree: native'.

assertions.name: manual-worktree-setup-is-documented
assertions.evidence: worktree_fallback.manual_steps: 'git worktree add -b <branch> ...', 'ln -s ../<repo>/node_modules', 'cp .env ../<wt-dir>/.env'. All 3 steps present.

assertions.name: fallback-stays-consistent-with-capabilities-ref
assertions.evidence: codex entry worktree: manual matches worktree_fallback.applies_to: [codex, cursor, gemini, kiro]. No contradiction.

assertions.name: background-task-gap-is-marked-na
assertions.evidence: capabilities.yaml codex: 'background_tasks: false'. Claude entry: 'background_tasks: true'. The gap is correctly represented.

assertions.name: mcp-access-is-allowed-because-cli-supports-it
assertions.evidence: capabilities.yaml codex: 'mcp_access: true  # codex mcp add — BrainLayer + Exa wired globally'. Not falsely marked unavailable.

assertions.name: shell-based-monitoring-fallback-remains-available
assertions.evidence: platform_features.background_tasks.universal: 'nohup command > log.txt 2>&1 &'. Universal fallback documented alongside Claude-native path.
